accuracy: Photo-based reconstruction. Room sizes, deck heights, concealed areas and machinery details are estimated; not a surveyed replica.
coordinate_system: glTF metres: X forward, Y up, Z starboard. Native Blender X forward, Y port, Z up.
conversion: Evaluated native meshes, curves and text; batched by original collection and material. No decimation. Generated BOX color projection converted to explicit UVs. Meshopt compression with 16-bit position quantization. Browser uses transparent glass and simplified bump/lighting; shader output is not pixel-identical to Cycles.
navigation: Walking uses conservative room bounds and furniture boxes. Room/deck destinations move through closed decorative doors; continuous stair traversal is not claimed. F enables free inspection.
marina_placement: Estimated installation at main quay; local datum and gangway are provisional. No surveyed berth or navigation-depth claim.
navigation_limitations: Conservative room bounds/furniture boxes; destination transitions bridge closed decorative doors. Continuous traversal of every stair and doorway is not implemented. Some compact crew camera presets use a crouched eye height.
